title: Captain Cutlass
description: A plugin that adds a pirate weapon, carves through enemies with spectral slashes, and unleash the Curse of the Black Tide.
body:
**Use /givecutlass or craft the weapon.**

- Custom model support (CustomModelData: 1)
- Configurable crafting recipe
- Two unique combat abilities
- Cooldown system
  
## Abilities

**🌊 Black Tide (/ab1)**
Unleash a cursed aura around yourself for 6 seconds.

**Effects:**
- Surrounds the player with ash, smoke, and sweeping attack particles
- Damages all nearby enemies within a 5-block radius
- Deals 4 damage every second
- Lasts 6 seconds
- 30 second cooldown

**⚔ Phantom Slash (/ab2)**
Launch a spectral sword slash in the direction you're looking.

**Effects:**
- Travels up to 12 blocks
- Damages each target only once
- Deals 10 damage
- Creates slash and cloud particle effects
- 15 second cooldown
  
## Crafting Recipe

The recipe is fully configurable through config.yml.

**Default recipe:**

[ ] [Wither Skeleton Skull] [ ]
[ ] [Wither Skeleton Skull] [ ]
[ ] [Stick]                 [ ]

```
recipe:
  shape:
    - " S "
    - " S "
    - " T "

  ingredients:
    S: WITHER_SKELETON_SKULL
    T: STICK
```
